summary: P0 fixes verified end-to-end via Playwright on the preview URL as the merchant (onarrival21). (1) Service product create+publish in one click WORKS: publish button is NOT disabled on a brand-new form, the 'Service — no digital delivery' option (data-testid=product-delivery-opt-none) appears in the delivery select, choosing it hides the Access URL field and shows the info note (data-testid=product-service-note), and clicking Publish issues POST /api/products then POST /api/products/:id/publish (both 200) and navigates to /pay-links/products/<id>/edit. Product ID 18 was created and then archived via data-testid=product-archive-btn (POST /api/products/18/archive 200). (2) URL-delivery regression: publishing without an access URL surfaces the toast 'Enter the access URL.', filling it lets publish succeed with status chip LIVE, then archived. (3) Support chat 'Talk to a human' pill is now clearly LABELED text ('Talk to a human') in the header, escalation form opens, POST /api/support/chat/escalate returns 200 and confirmation 'Your conversation has been forwarded to our support team...' appears in the thread. All three P0 fixes pass. One minor UX issue: escalating BEFORE sending any message returns 400 'No conversation found for this session.' (the widget needs at least one user message to seed the session before /escalate accepts).

minor.issue: Returns 400 'No conversation found for this session.' when the user opens the chat panel and clicks 'Talk to a human' immediately without first sending a message. Once at least one message is sent, escalate returns 200. Consider auto-creating a session on widget open or letting /escalate lazily create one so the pill works from a cold-open state.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking 'Talk to a human' immediately after opening the panel (no prior message) shows an inline error 'No conversation found for this session.' The escalate form still submits but the API 400s. Works fine once any message is exchanged.

action_items: OPTIONAL/minor: seed the chat conversation on support widget open OR make POST /api/support/chat/escalate lazily create a session, so 'Talk to a human' works even without a prior user message.
critical_code_review_comments: buildPayload/validate/publish logic for the new 'none' delivery option is correct; publish() correctly creates-then-publishes for new products in one round-trip.
publishProduct backend gate correctly only enforces a digital_delivery_type when product_type==='digital' — service products publish with null delivery as designed.

Test-side note: the [data-testid=support-chat-escalate-email] wrapper is on a MUI InputBase div; the actual <input> is a descendant. Playwright fill needs to target the inner input. Not a bug, just a testability tip.
test_credentials: onarrival21@gmail.com / Katiekendra123@ (user_id=1, company_id=1 'The Dev Store'). No 2FA challenge was triggered during this run.
seed_data_creation: Two throwaway products were created on The Dev Store during testing and BOTH were archived: product_id 18 (service, $25, 'TEST Service P0a') and one URL-delivery product ('TEST URL P0a', $20, https://example.com/dl/test-p0a). No other merchant data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 bug fixes for service-product publish and labeled 'Talk to a human' escalation are verified passing on the preview URL. Live prod DB is clean — test products 18 (service) and the URL-delivery one were archived. The only leftover minor issue is the cold-open /escalate 400 when no message has been sent yet; not a regression, likely pre-existing behavior. Login stayed on 2-step (no 2FA). Cloudflare occasionally 502s intermittently on the preview host; retry usually resolves.
rca of the issue: Original bug 1 root cause: Publish button was guarded by `!product` (nothing saved yet) AND the delivery select forced url/file/license with Access URL mandatory. Fix: added {v:'none'} 'Service — no digital delivery' option, buildPayload sets product_type='service' + digital_delivery_type=null when deliveryType==='none', validate() only requires access URL when deliveryType==='url', publish button disabled only when saving||publishing, and publish() creates-then-publishes new products in one click. Verified: fresh form Publish enabled=true, service note visible, no access-url field, POST /api/products 200 → POST /api/products/:id/publish 200, chip LIVE. Original bug 2 root cause: escalate control was an unlabeled headset icon. Fix: header pill now shows the text 'Talk to a human'. Verified visually and by testid.
